body:
Track 1 follow-up to `selfrep-redesign`: replaces the assumed wooden-rod penalty with an Euler–Bernoulli beam model. At 8 mm on an assumed 400 mm span, birch sags ~17× and printed PLA ~80× as much as steel; matching steel stiffness needs ~16 mm / ~24 mm. Stylised: moduli, loads and limits are assumptions; nothing measured.

Tests: 6 pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
